result.quote: But Paul went down, threw himself on the young man, and embraced him. “Do not be alarmed!” he said. “He is still alive!”
result.reason: The window supports that the young man fell, was picked up dead, and was afterward declared alive. However, it does not explicitly say Paul revived him; “He is still alive” can mean that he had not actually died. The answer should avoid asserting Paul’s causation, for example: “He fell from the third story, was picked up dead, and was then found to be alive.”
